description: Canonical ABI and toolchain contract for mewla Android and iOS libghostty-vt builds. Invalid combinations are not supported.

ghostty.commit_note: The commit the signed tag points at, for traceability. Builds use the signed release tarballs below, never a git checkout.

release.signature_verified_at_lock_time: minisign over SHA256SUMS and over both tarballs, 2026-11-12

ghostty.headers_sha256_note: sha256 of the sorted '<sha256>  <path>' lines of every file under include/ghostty in the source tarball (scripts/lib/ghostty_release.py headers-digest)
ghostty.third_party_manifest: deps/libghostty-vt-third-party.json inside the source tarball; linked: highway (Apache-2.0 OR BSD-3-Clause), simdutf (Apache-2.0 OR MIT), uucode (MIT AND Unicode-3.0), wuffs (Apache-2.0 OR MIT), translate_c (MIT)

zig.minimum_zig_version_source: minimum_zig_version in build.zig.zon of the source tarball; 1.0.1 needs 0.17.x (same minor, any newer patch)

android.ndk_note: Verified via ELF .note.android.ident API level 29 (0x1d) on libghostty_vt.so built from the vt-1.0.0 release (re-verify on 1.0.1); file(1) reports 'for Android 29'.
android.source_patches_note: None: the Android shm_open fix (ghostty adb0d793) is part of vt-1.0.1, and the build now takes the signed release tarball unmodified.

ios.notice_packaging: Expo plugin withIOSBuild copies into the iOS app bundle; verified by scripts/verify-ios-artifact.sh for Simulator .app and IPA

desktop.note: Static libghostty-vt for the daemon's session host: Go package daemon/ghosttyvt, build tag ghosttyvt. Same signed release and Zig as the app. Built by scripts/build-libghostty-desktop.sh.
desktop.lib_dir_note: Gitignored. A mewla-dev build adds the ghosttyvt tag only when this directory exists; tests and CI use a cache outside the checkout. Release binaries link the *_musl libraries statically on Linux (scripts/build-daemon-linux.sh).

release_apk.note: Sideload beta ships arm64-v8a only. x86_64 is for emulator/dev builds. Notice is packaged via Expo plugin withAndroidRelease into android assets (verified by scripts/verify-apk-notice.sh). iOS notice packaging is owned by withIOSBuild.

signing.mechanism: Gradle System.getenv via withAndroidRelease plugin; never commit secrets
